title: a2a impl-lane result
description: The result an impl-lane worker writes. This IS devloop's `sample-task-result.json` shape, so a devloop-dispatched worker's result is parsed by devloop step 4.3.4 without an adapter. a2a itself enforces only the top-level `required` list (src/reconcile.rs::schema_gate); the rest of this document is the published contract and the `--output-schema` payload handed to codex. Every object here is CLOSED (additionalProperties: false) with a complete `required` list because the model API's strict structured outputs demand it — the first real impl spawn was rejected with invalid_json_schema: "In context=('properties','evidence'), 'additionalProperties' is required to be supplied and to be false." (bug a2a-5n2, 2026-08-24). Evidence is therefore narrowed to `logs_excerpts`: cli/api tasks — the only kinds dispatched to codex — carry log excerpts; richer toolkit evidence (screenshots etc.) belongs to Claude-side subagents, whose results are not schema-gated by the API.

status.description: `pass` only when every acceptance criterion was verified; `stuck` when the same failure repeated and the work needs a human.

iterations.description: How many implement/verify cycles this task took.

summary.description: What was done and what was verified, in prose, with the evidence that backs each claim.

evidence.description: Verification evidence. Closed object per strict structured outputs; `logs_excerpts` is the one universal channel — command output excerpts backing the summary's claims.

files_changed.description: Every file this task created or modified, repo-relative.

next_step_hint.description: One sentence for whoever picks the work up next, or null when there is nothing to hand over.
